$description: BulletChart (platform/charts/BulletChart.jsx, library wave 9, lane B): its component tokens. The value bar is the frame's mark (chart-*); the ranges are three neutral shades from existing surface and border roles (distinct in light and dark) and the target the default content color. No new color.

bullet-chart-range-poor-background.$description: Bullet chart: the lowest range (poor), the darkest of the three neutral shades.

bullet-chart-range-good-background.$description: Bullet chart: the highest range (good), the lightest shade.

bullet-chart-target-color.$description: Bullet chart: the target line across the value bar.

bullet-chart-target-width.$description: Bullet chart: the target line's width.
